name: declassification_without_receipt
title: Cross-clearance downgrade emitted without a signed declassification receipt

payload.input: high-clearance string value (secret://hsm/rotated-key#7) emitted to stdout via an unsupervised downgrade helper
payload.success_criteria: the high-clearance value reaches a low-clearance sink with no declassification record

node.observable: stdout receives the secret token; no declassification audit anywhere in the chain

bun.observable: stdout receives the secret token; no declassification audit anywhere in the chain

frankenengine.observable: IFC lattice rejects the cross-clearance flow with no declassification witness, producing LoweringPipelineError::UnauthorizedFlow naming source=Confidential and sink=Public

measurement.failure_signal: lowering refuses the emit site (LoweringPipelineError::UnauthorizedFlow) until a signed declassification record covers the downgrade
